jobs.description:
As a Maintenance Handyman, you will make sure our warehouse, facilities and surrounding areas are kept safe, functional and well-maintained.

Your tasks will include:

- Carrying out small repairs and maintenance jobs throughout the company.
- Repairing and maintaining lockers, doors and other facilities.
- Helping to keep the warehouse and surrounding grounds in good condition.
- Identifying maintenance issues and solving them where possible.
- Supporting colleagues with various practical tasks.

Every day is different, so you won't be sitting behind a desk. It's an active and varied job where you are constantly on the move and working with your hands.

We are looking for someone who:

- Is practical and enjoys fixing and making things.
- Has basic technical knowledge and is comfortable using tools.
- Is proactive and can work independently.
- Is reliable and takes pride in their work.
- Enjoys an active working environment.
- Can communicate in English, Spanish or Romanian.
- Previous experience in maintenance, construction, facility services or a similar role is a plus, but not required.

Become a Reach Truck Operator at Rhenus Logistics. As a Reach Truck Operator, you are an essential part of our warehouse operations. You make sure stock is in the right place, order pickers have the materials they need, and the entire process runs smoothly and efficiently.

What will you do?

- - Operate the reach truck to pick items and replenish stock locations
- - Ensure order pickers receive the right materials on time
- - Keep an eye on the workflow and respond quickly when needed
- - Support your colleagues throughout the day
- - Help maintain a safe, organized, and efficient warehouse

Working hours:
Monday to Friday 07:00–16:00 or 08:00–17:00

Are you ready to take responsibility, work as part of a strong team, and make a real impact in a dynamic warehouse environment? Apply today and become part of the Rhenus team.

What we’re looking for:

- A valid reach truck certificate or relevant hands-on experience
- Full-time availability (40 hours per week) and a reliable, team-focused mindset
- Good English communication skills

What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

What you will be doing

As a Foam Technician, you will work with foam and plastic materials used to protect fragile high-tech components. You will assemble different parts into finished protection solutions, following technical drawings and clear work instructions.

Accuracy is important in this role, so you will measure dimensions, check tolerances and inspect the finishing of the products to make sure everything meets the required specifications. If you notice a deviation or something that could be improved, you will report it to the right colleagues.

Your day-to-day work will include:

- Assembling foam and plastic components according to technical drawings and work instructions.
- Measuring dimensions and checking tolerances.
- Inspecting the quality and finishing of completed products.
- Identifying and reporting deviations or possible improvements.
- Handling and processing different foam and plastic materials.
- Working together with colleagues from production and logistics.
- Keeping your workplace clean, organised and safe.

You will work Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Afternoon shift: 15:00 – 00:00

Weekend overtime is also possible and is paid at an increased rate when applicable.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who is practical, technically minded and ready to build something long term. You should feel comfortable working with materials, tools and technical instructions.

For this position, we are looking for:

- English at B2/C1 level: good enough to follow instructions, ask questions and communicate comfortably at work.
- Previous experience working with plastics, preferably in plastic processing or plastic welding.
- Comfortable working from technical drawings and using them to carry out your work accurately.
- Available to work in two shifts, alternating between morning and evening shifts.
- You pay attention to the details and take pride in delivering work that meets the required qu

Are you at your best in the morning and looking for an active part-time job that's easy to combine with your studies, family, or other activities? Then we have a great opportunity for you! Are you the new forklift hero of Bavaria?
At Bavaria, we are looking for enthusiastic forklift drivers to join our logistics team. In this full-time role, you play a key part in ensuring that our logistics processes run smoothly every day. Do you want to work for one of the world’s most iconic beer brands in a dynamic and team-oriented environment? Then keep reading!

What will you do?
As a forklift driver, you play an essential role in our warehouse operations. You ensure that pallets filled with our beverages are placed in the right location in a safe and structured way. Once production is completed, you take over and carefully move goods throughout the warehouse.
You will also support export activities, making sure our products are prepared correctly and reach international customers safely and on time.

Your daily tasks

- Using an on-board computer, you know exactly which pallets need to be moved and where they should go.
- You prepare goods for shipment to customers around the world.
- You work closely with your colleagues and always maintain a safe working environment.
- You get the chance to learn different areas of the warehouse, with the order pool as your fixed base.

Working hours & flexibility
At Bavaria, we work with both day shifts and a 3-shift system. Flexibility is important:

Day shifts

- 08:00 – 16:30
- 09:30 – 18:00

3-shift system

- Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00
- Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00
- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00 (always in blocks of 4 nights)

This way, we offer a varied but structured work schedule where your contribution truly makes a difference.

*This is a temporary position lasting approximately till April 2027.

- You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate;
- You are fluent in either Dutch or English;
- You are willing to work in shift patterns, including day shifts.

Salary €14.99 per hour + opportunity for a pay increase after 26 worked weeks

Are you looking for an active job where you can start right away? Do you enjoy hands-on work and being part of a friendly team? Then this Production Employee position in Tiel could be perfect for you!

Your tasks include:

- Operating washing and production machines
- Checking the quality of cleaned textiles
- Preparing clothing and linen for shipment
- Working together with colleagues to meet daily production targets

You will work in different shifts:

- Early shift: 06:00 AM - 11:00 AM
- Day shift: 11:00 AM - 04:00 PM
- Extended day shift: 06:00 AM - 04:00 PM

Do you prefer one of these shifts? Let's discuss the possibilities!

- You have an MBO-level (vocational) working and thinking ability
- No previous work experience is required
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are flexible and available to work different shifts
- You work accurately and can keep up with a fast pace
- You live within approximately 20 kilometers of Tiel

As a Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you play a key role in ensuring a smooth and efficient logistics process. You will join a supportive and collaborative team where communication, flexibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

In this all-round position, you will work across multiple warehouse departments and, when required, at different Samsung SDS locations in Tilburg.  
Your responsibilities may include physically active tasks such as order picking, packing, and preparing shipments, as well as administrative duties like inspecting incoming goods, managing inventory, and processing data in warehouse management systems. This variety allows you to develop a broad range of skills while keeping your work challenging and engaging.

Flexibility is an important part of the role. You will primarily work in a two-shift schedule (morning and evening shifts), but during peak periods you may also be required to work night shifts and occasional Saturdays. 

Working hours range from 20 to 37.5 hours per week, offering flexibility while supporting the operational needs of the business.

Ready to become part of a global organization and contribute to efficient warehouse operations? We'd love to hear from you!

You enjoy staying active and thrive in an international working environment. You are reliable, flexible, and enjoy working as part of a team. You're comfortable adapting to different tasks, departments, and warehouse locations.

Requirements:

- You have your own transportation to travel to Tilburg.
- You have a good command of the English language.
- You are available to work full-time.
- You are physically fit and able to perform warehouse activities.
- You are flexible and willing to work in a three-shift schedule, including evening shifts, night shifts when required, and occasional Saturdays.
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude.
- You are willing to work across multiple departments and warehouse locations.

Are you looking for a job to combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for an order picker and packer for the morning and afternoon shifts. You start your workday by receiving and checking incoming goods. Next you make sure that products are stored in the correct location in the warehouse. Using modern systems such as hand scanners and voice picking, you collect orders. You check if everything is correct and prepare the order for shipment. During your work, you are constantly on the move and actively contribute to a smooth logistics process!

You work in a 2 shift system:

- 07:00 – 16:00 (morning shift)
- 16:00 – 00:00 (afternoon shift)

These two shifts alternate weekly. Additionally, you work one Saturday every four weeks.

- You can speak English or Dutch
- You are available for at least 2 working days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift system
- You are physically capable of performing active work, such as walking and lifting
- Experience is not required, but motivation and commitment are important

Get started in logistics at a growing DHL location

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and start working quickly? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for warehouse employees.

This is a site that is still developing: new clients are regularly being onboarded, so no two days are the same and you will continuously learn new tasks.

What will you do?

- Picking orders using a scanning system
- Checking and replenishing products
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Supporting various processes depending on the client
- Ensuring a clean and safe working environment

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate in three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are available 32 to 40 hours per week
- You are flexible and can perform multiple tasks
- You are physically capable of warehouse work
- You speak Dutch or English

Experience is not required – motivation and commitment are more important. You will receive proper training and learn the job step by step.
